text: The atmosphere was great overall. Normally, my son doesn't have a regular dentist; he's happy with whichever doctor he sees. This time, we saw the owner, and my son was happy as usual. However, the parents weren't happy. We were charged 400 baht for a toothbrushing lesson without any prior notice. The final bill came to 2,500 baht. I thought, "Why so expensive this time?" but didn't think much of it because we had an X-ray. It was only when I saw the receipt later when I went to collect my US points that I was so disappointed. When the dentist showed me the X-ray, she even praised his teeth, saying there were no cavities, which was great. I asked if I usually brushed my son's teeth for him, and I said yes, my husband and I take turns. The dentist then offered to demonstrate brushing techniques, which I agreed to. But she didn't inform me of any charges at all. If there's going to be a charge, it should have been communicated at the time, allowing the client to decide. Finding out later was incredibly disappointing.
